releaseNotes:
1. Feeder Row Auto-Resize: Feeder names wrap automatically onto multiple lines without height clipping, and Tower Count remains always visible below the title for both Tamil and English feeders.
2. Tower Marker Drag & Drop: Long-press any tower marker to enter Move Mode and drag to reposition. Automatically updates coordinates in SQLite database and refreshes feeder lines.
3. Safe Feeder Association: Guaranteed tower isolation across different feeders using stable composite identifiers.
4. Feeder Line Geometry & Distance Sync: Polyline vertices and cumulative transmission-line distances update dynamically when a tower moves.
5. Move Undo Support: One-tap 'UNDO' action in confirmation toast restores original database coordinates and polyline geometry.
6. KMZ / KML Export Compatibility: Coordinate modifications are preserved in database and exported KMZ/KML packages without corrupting source files.
